title: Export

formats.svg: SVG, 1:1 for laser, cutter or other apps
formats.dxf: DXF, 1:1 in mm for laser and CNC software
formats.png: PNG picture, to share or preview

dxf.noLabels: DXF has the shapes only: labels are left out.

png.hint: A picture for sharing. For making the pattern, use PDF, SVG or DXF.

polyline: Curves as short straight lines (for laser software)

pdf.single: One page, sized to the pattern
pdf.printHint: Print at 100 % ("Actual size"); never "Fit to page". Then measure the 50 mm square on the first page.
pdf.calibration: 50 mm: measure this square to check the print scale
pdf.instructions1: Print at 100 % / "Actual size". Do not use "Fit to page" or "Shrink oversized pages".
pdf.instructions2: Measure the square: it must be exactly 50 mm on each side. If not, check the printer scaling and print again.
pdf.assembly: Sheets overlap by {overlap} mm. Trim along a dashed line or overlap the sheets, matching the corner marks and the sheet labels at the edges.

aiUnreviewed: {count, plural, one {# object was created by AI and has not been reviewed.} other {# objects were created by AI and have not been reviewed.}}
